title: 🚀 Introducing Managed Agents API – Build, Manage & Publish Agents Programmatically!
text:
Create, update, publish, and manage Managed Agents directly through HighLevel APIs! 🤖
With the new Managed Agents API, you can build AI agents using natural-language instructions, automate their setup, and manage their entire lifecycle without opening Agent Studio.✨ What's New?
🤖 Complete Agent Lifecycle via API
Create Agents: Describe what you need, and AI automatically builds the agent, including subagents when required.
Update Agents: Refine existing agents using simple natural-language instructions.
Guided Setup: The builder asks for missing details, which your application can provide.
Publish & Unpublish: Take agents live or pause them with a single API request.
Built-in Validation: Automatically check whether an agent is ready to publish.🔐 Secure API Access
Dedicated permission scope for building and publishing agents.
Access through HighLevel Private Integrations.
Creating, publishing, and unpublishing agents is free; agent executions follow standard usage pricing.
💡 What Can You Build?
White-Label AI Builders: Let customers create agents directly from your application.
Automated Onboarding: Deploy agents across multiple sub-accounts.
Agency Agent Libraries: Create reusable agents for clients.
Campaign Automation: Publish or unpublish agents based on business needs.
AI-Powered Agent Creation: Enable AI assistants to build and deploy Managed Agents.
🛠️ How to Get Started
Create a Private Integration in your HighLevel sub-account.
Enable the Managed Agents build and publish permission.
Use the API to create, update, and publish agents.
Execute published agents through the existing API.
🎯 Why It Matters
Full Automation: Manage the complete agent lifecycle through APIs.
Faster Deployment: Build and publish agents without manual configuration.
Scalable: Automate agent creation across client accounts.
Flexible Integration: Bring Managed Agents into your own products and workflows.
📢 Availability
Available for all sub-accounts through Private Integrations.
📚 API Documentation: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/agent-studio/managed-agents
Build Agents. Automate Deployment. Scale with APIs. 🚀
